instruction: Configure the automatic saving frequency to every 10 minutes to minimize disk activity and ensure backups.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting auto-save interval to 10 minutes in LibreOffice Impress via Tools > Options > Load/Save > General settings. The evaluator uses the existing check_auto_saving_time metric to verify the AutoSaveTimeIntervall value in registrymodifications.xcu matches 10 minutes. This is a paraphrased variation of the original task with a different time interval.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_vm_file retrieves the LibreOffice configuration file from the correct path (/home/user/.config/libreoffice/4/user/registrymodifications.xcu)

Metric logic is correct: check_auto_saving_time properly parses the XML file, searches for the correct path (/org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/Document) and property (AutoSaveTimeIntervall), and compares the value against expected minutes
Complete coverage: The evaluator fully verifies the instruction requirement - checking that auto-save interval is set to 10 minutes
Expected value is semantically correct: 10 minutes matches the instruction requirement
State accessibility is reliable: The configuration file is persistent and doesn't require any UI dialog to be open, no postconfig needed
Data flow is correct: File retrieval → XML parsing → value extraction → comparison works logically at runtime
